title: SedimentDepositRequest
description: Payload a microservice POSTs to {mycelium}/api/sediment to bulk-deposit historical readings straight into sealed Sapwood buckets. Shape derived from vos.Service.Shared.MyceliumClientBase.DepositSedimentAsync and Mycelium's SedimentItem[]. Entities must already exist; observedAt is required because sediment is historical.

objectId.description: Id of the (already-existing) entity (thing or relationship) the reading belongs to.

property.description: Name of the property on the entity.

value.description: The historical value: any JSON scalar (string, number, boolean) or null.

observedAt.description: Observed-time as an ISO-8601 string. Required — sediment is historical, not live.
